candidate_relations.reason: The delayed UVA erythema, chronic pruritic papules, and lower-lip cheilitis support actinic prurigo with associated cheilitis. The CD20-positive, BCL-2-negative reactive follicles may represent associated cutaneous lymphoid hyperplasia but do not identify the requested final diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Reactive B-cell lymphoid hyperplasia is a histopathologic finding rather than the full photodermatosis diagnosis with lip involvement.
